params.prompt: Photorealistic photograph, straight-on at counter height. The walk-up service window of a small Los Angeles food stand: bright red textured stucco wall, a red-painted wooden counter shelf held up by red wooden brackets, mounted on a base of brown brick with light mortar lines. Above the counter, a row of white-framed sliding glass windows with one pane slid open, showing a soft glimpse of a warm yellow-lit kitchen inside. Strings of colorful papel picado flags (magenta, turquoise, yellow, lime green, orange) hang along the top edge. On the counter, food just handed out: queso birria tacos with pink pickled onions in a paper tray lined with green-and-white checkered paper and a cup of esquite on the left; on the right, a white bowl of kebab over basmati rice with hummus, cucumber salad and pink pickled onions, and a tall cup of watermelon agua fresca with ice. A vertical white window mullion divides the image roughly in half, Mexican food on the left and Mediterranean food on the right. Bright afternoon Los Angeles sun with crisp shadows, rich saturated red, tack-sharp detail, natural color. No text, no menus, no screens, no signs, no logos, no labels, no people, no hands.
